caption: The drawing depicts a decorative cup with two handles, rendered in pencil on a beige or off-white background. The main object, occupying the center of the composition, is a wide, shallow bowl with a scalloped rim and ornate, twisted handles on each side. The bowl's surface displays symmetrical, fan-like patterns that resemble stylized leaves or feathers, placed evenly between the four segments outlined by subtle ridges on the cup. The handles are thick and appear twisted, looping away from the cup in a semi-circular shape. Beneath the main depiction, in the lower left corner, is a smaller, simplified outline of the same cup shown in profile, emphasizing the handle's design and the central motif on the cup’s body. The entire drawing is enclosed within a thin rectangular border, and there is a small printed label with the text "Michael Fening" at the bottom right outside the border. The composition uses shades of gray graphite, with no use of color other than the paper's natural tone.
title: Silver Bowl
